story.headline: A cradle is where something new is kept safe while it grows.
body: Builders carry a lot in their heads. Kraddle is where the work lives while it takes shape, keeping track of how the project is meant to hold together.
You shouldn't have to watch over it. You should feel it holding.

markNote: Two identical halves, each turned half a turn onto the other, with square ends. The name is one weight step lighter than the mark so both read as the same weight.

wordmark.note: Mark height is 0.82 × the name's font size; the gap is 0.32 × the font size.

logoRules: Ink on paper, or paper on ink. The logo itself is never orange or green.
Keep clear space of at least half the mark's width on every side.
Smallest size: the mark 16px tall on screens. Below that, use the mark without the name.
Never round the ends, stretch, outline, or add shadows or gradients.
